top_stories.title: Gemini 4 Argon: Built to solve your hardest problems
top_stories.summary: Google DeepMind has officially released Gemini 4 Argon, its latest flagship model designed for complex reasoning and problem-solving tasks. The launch is accompanied by dedicated posts on responsible development and robotics applications, signalling a broad deployment push across Google's product ecosystem.

top_stories.title: Developing Gemini 4 Argon responsibly and safely
top_stories.summary: Google DeepMind published a dedicated safety report alongside the Gemini 4 Argon launch, detailing the measures taken to evaluate and mitigate risks from the new model. The post covers evaluation frameworks, red-teaming efforts, and DeepMind's approach to responsible scaling.

top_stories.title: OpenAI and Anthropic Tell British Lawmakers: Regulate Us [Metered]
top_stories.summary: OpenAI and Anthropic have jointly urged UK parliamentarians to introduce AI regulation, arguing that a clear legal framework would benefit both public safety and industry development. The move marks a notable instance of leading AI labs actively inviting government oversight.

top_stories.title: Character.ai has initiated voluntary Chapter 11 bankruptcy
top_stories.summary: Character.ai has filed for voluntary Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection, marking a significant collapse for one of the most prominent AI chatbot platforms. The company's official blog post confirms the filing and outlines plans for the reorganisation process.

top_stories.title: Meta's Generative Ads Model (GEM): Scaling the Central Model and Compute Engine for Frontier Ads AI
top_stories.summary: Meta's engineering blog details GEM, its large-scale generative model purpose-built for advertising, describing how the system centralises ad creative generation and optimisation at scale. The post outlines the compute infrastructure and training approach underpinning Meta's frontier ads AI strategy.

further_links.title: OpenAI employee arrested for allegedly planting a bug in a conference room
further_links.summary: An OpenAI employee was arrested after allegedly using a chatbot to assist in planting a recording device inside a company conference room, raising questions about insider security risks at leading AI labs.

further_links.title: Gemini 4 Argon for Robotics
further_links.summary: Google DeepMind outlines how Gemini 4 Argon is being applied to robotics, detailing new capabilities in physical world understanding and robot control that the model enables.

further_links.title: Open models have real benefits. Do they outweigh the risks? [Metered]
further_links.summary: MIT Technology Review examines the trade-offs of open AI models, weighing the benefits of broad access and research transparency against concerns about misuse and safety risks.

further_links.title: AI labs are buying data from dead startups to train their models [Metered]
further_links.summary: MIT Technology Review reports that AI companies are purchasing datasets from failed startups to use in model training, raising questions about data provenance, user consent, and privacy.

further_links.title: Threat of AI share crash puts world financial stability at risk, says IMF
further_links.summary: The IMF has warned that an AI-driven stock market correction poses a material risk to global financial stability, citing concerns over concentrated valuations and cyber vulnerabilities linked to AI adoption.

further_links.title: Wikipedians Believed AI Would Come and Go. They Were Wrong [Metered]
further_links.summary: An excerpt from a forthcoming book explores how the Wikipedia community initially dismissed AI as a passing trend, and how the rise of generative AI has since fundamentally disrupted the encyclopaedia's editor community and information model.

further_links.title: Google DeepMind and Singapore Government announce new AI tool to protect citizens against scams
further_links.summary: Google DeepMind has partnered with the Singapore government to deploy an on-device AI scam detection tool aimed at protecting citizens from fraud in real time.

further_links.title: Epic shifts to 'AI-accelerated development' for upcoming Disney game
further_links.summary: Epic Games has announced it is adopting AI-accelerated development workflows, including AI coding and art tools, for its upcoming Disney-branded game project.

further_links.title: The Biggest Pro-AI Super PAC Network Has Poured Millions Into Nevada Shell Companies [Metered]
further_links.summary: Wired investigates a network of pro-AI political action committees that have channelled millions of dollars through Nevada shell companies, raising transparency concerns about AI industry political spending.

further_links.title: Shopify opens its catalog up to more AI agents
further_links.summary: Shopify is expanding access to its product catalogue for third-party AI agents, enabling more automated commerce workflows and agent-driven shopping experiences.
